name: Don's Curse
source:
Don is always in a bad mood, cursing everyone for any reason. One day, his ill behavior ends up annoying the Goddess of the Sea, who places a terrible curse on him.

Now, whenever he curses someone, the goddess' curse strikes him back, turning him into a donkey. Will he be able to break this spell somehow? And is anyone willing to help such an ill behaved guy?

Don's Curse is a Game-Boy-inspired visual novel adventure. Investigate supernatural occurrences in University Town and its surroundings, and help Don undo this terrible curse that was cast upon him.

[From [url=https://rafaiska.itch.io/dons-curse]Itch.io[/url]]
